en.intro: Krishna has just said he appears when dharma declines. Now he tells Arjuna the exact purpose behind that appearing. Listen for the three tasks that drive his descent.
en.notice: Krishna comes age after age to protect the good, destroy wrongdoers and re-establish dharma.
en.next: Krishna then tells Arjuna that understanding this cycle of appearing and acting in the world is the key to liberation.
en.meaning: For the protection of the righteous, for the destruction of wrongdoers, and for the establishment of dharma, I appear age after age.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी कहा था कि जब धर्म का पतन होता है तो वे प्रकट होते हैं। अब वे अर्जुन को उस प्रकट होने के पीछे का असली मकसद बताते हैं। तीन काम सुनिए जो उनके आने का कारण हैं।
hi.meaning: साधुओं की रक्षा करने, पापियों का नाश करने और धर्म की स्थापना करने के लिए मैं युग-युग में प्रकट होता हूँ।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर अर्जुन को बताते हैं कि इस प्रकट होने और कर्म करने के चक्र को समझना ही मुक्ति की कुंजी है।

en.intro: Krishna has just said he appears when dharma declines. Now he tells Arjuna the exact purpose behind that appearing. Listen for the three tasks that drive his descent.
en.body: For the protection of the righteous, for the destruction of wrongdoers, and for the establishment of dharma, I appear age after age. Krishna comes age after age to protect the good, destroy wrongdoers and re-establish dharma. Krishna then tells Arjuna that understanding this cycle of appearing and acting in the world is the key to liberation.

borrowed: "Notice the phrase 'age after age', युगे युगे. Krishna does not say he will appear once to end the war; he says he returns repeatedly to restore balance, protect the good, and remove the destructive." (The phrase 'end the war' is not found in the source verse 8. It borrows the specific context of the Kurukshetra war from the surrounding narrative and incorrectly implies that verse 8 is addressing the duration or frequency of his appearance in the war, rather than the general cyclical purpose of his incarnations.)
en.notice: Devanagari in English, write Sanskrit words in plain Roman letters

meaning_changed: "साधुओं के संरक्षण, पापियों के विनाश और धर्म की स्थापना के लिए मैं युग-युग में प्रकट होता हूँ" (The Hindi translation drops the 'I' (मैं), making it sound like an impersonal statement rather than Krishna's personal declaration ('I appear'). It also changes 'for the protection of the righteous' to 'for the protection of the saints/devotees' (साधुओं के संरक्षण), which narrows the scope of 'sadhu' (righteous/good people) to 'saints/devotees'.)
en.notice: Devanagari in English, write Sanskrit words in plain Roman letters

meaning_changed: "धर्म की भलीभाँति स्थापना करनेके लिये मैं युग-युगमें प्रकट हुआ करता हूँ।" (The Hindi meaning drops the two explicit purposes of 'protection of the righteous' and 'destruction of wrongdoers', reducing the three tasks to only one: establishment of dharma. This omits a core part of the verse's meaning.)
